campgrounds.name: Upper Pines
campgrounds.reservation: Recreation.gov, 5 months ahead on the 15th; reservation required year-round
notes: The dump station, with fresh water, stays open all year.
From December to mid-February only the first three loops, about 90 sites, are normally open (NPS road data).

campgrounds.name: Lower Pines
campgrounds.rvLimit: RV 40 ft / trailer 35 ft (six sites of that size)
notes: On the bank of the Merced.
Closed from late October to early April (NPS road data).

campgrounds.name: North Pines
campgrounds.reservation: Lottery or Recreation.gov, 5 months ahead on the 15th
campgrounds.rvLimit: RV 40 ft / trailer 35 ft (two sites of that size)
notes: Between the Merced and Tenaya Creek.

campgrounds.name: Camp 4
campgrounds.reservation: Recreation.gov, 1 week ahead, required Apr 15–Nov 29, 2026 (extended; last reservation night Nov 28); first-come after that
campgrounds.rvLimit: Walk-in, tents only; no RVs or trailers
notes: Sites are shared by up to six people; the historic climbers' camp sits near shuttle stop 7.

campgrounds.name: Wawona
campgrounds.reservation: Recreation.gov, 5 months ahead on the 15th for Apr 15–Oct 26 (Loops B and C, which then close for the season) and Apr 15–Nov 29 (Loop A, extended; last reserved night Nov 28); Loop A first-come otherwise
notes: Group and horse sites must be reserved.
The dump station near the campground runs in summer only.

campgrounds.name: Bridalveil Creek
campgrounds.season: Closed for 2026 since Aug 14 (lightning strike damaged water and restrooms); normally about Jul–early Sep
notes: Group and horse sites in summer.

campgrounds.name: Hodgdon Meadow
campgrounds.reservation: Recreation.gov, 5 months ahead on the 15th for Apr 15–Oct 26; first-come after Oct 26
notes: Close to the Big Oak Flat Entrance.
Campfires only between 5 and 10 pm, the same rule as the Valley.

campgrounds.name: Crane Flat
notes: Near the Crane Flat gas station and the Tuolumne and Merced sequoia groves.

campgrounds.name: Tamarack Flat
notes: Reached by a rough three-mile road off Tioga Road.

campgrounds.name: Yosemite Creek
notes: Reached by a rough five-mile road off Tioga Road.

campgrounds.name: Tuolumne Meadows
campgrounds.reservation: Recreation.gov, 2 months ahead on the 15th plus 14 days ahead
notes: Group and horse sites must be reserved.
The Tuolumne Meadows dump station has been closed since September 8, 2026 for wastewater-plant work, until further notice.

guidance.label: Reservations
guidance.detail: Required for all campgrounds from about April through October and extremely hard to get; book as early as the window allows. Until Oct 26, 2026 every campground requires a reservation (Guide 51.8). Wawona Loops B and C then close for the season (Oct 26) and Hodgdon Meadow becomes first-come; Camp 4 and Wawona Loop A require reservations until Nov 29 (last reserved night Nov 28), then are first-come (NPS campgrounds update, Sep 28, 2026).

guidance.label: Campfires
guidance.detail: Allowed in fire rings while attended, but only 5–10 pm in Yosemite Valley campgrounds and Hodgdon Meadow. Consider skipping the fire: night-time inversions trap smoke in campgrounds.

guidance.label: Food storage
guidance.detail: All food and scented items go in the site's bear locker. Hard-sided RVs may hold food out of sight with windows and vents closed; soft-sided campers may not.

guidance.label: RVs and trailers
guidance.detail: No hookups anywhere in the park. Dump stations at Upper Pines (all year) and near Wawona (summer). Generators only 7–9 am, noon–2 pm, and 5–7 pm. Valley maximum is 40 ft RV / 35 ft trailer at just eight sites; most sites take 35 ft RVs or 24 ft trailers.

guidance.label: Sleeping in vehicles
guidance.detail: Only at a registered campsite; never at roadsides or in parking areas.

guidance.label: Showers
guidance.detail: Curry Village pool showerhouse, for a fee; nowhere else in the park.

guidance.label: Backcountry
guidance.detail: Little Yosemite Valley and the High Sierra camp campgrounds are outside the reservation system and need a wilderness permit.
